patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Windows: Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'adult.rpa' file from the patch archive into the 'game' folder mentioned above Mac: Right click the app and click "Show Package Contents" Navigate into Cont It's working if: You have the option to switch between standard and Limited Edition modes.
